_comment: Mutation testing for the context interviews (docs/architecture/context-interviews.md): reading a transcript (txt/docx/vtt/srt), the one check every claim passes (verbatim quote, period dates, attribute keys, confidence), the prompt and reply schema, the reply check and repair round, splitting and de-duplicating, matching a spoken name to the interviewee / an account / a first name the context knows, the fixed role-deduction rules, the relevance tier (which claims are folded away as less relevant), where a quote stands in the transcript (the highlight offsets), reading a they-left claim against its whole sentence, proposing another name the speaker uses for the context, what the members lists show from the interviews (latest role, left, previous members and their live entitlements), the alias-aware context-name matcher, deciding a claim (description append, attribute write, Accountable conflict, Responsible add) and the routes with their reader narrowing. WHY THESE FILES: every failure here is silent -- a quote check one step too loose lets a claim rest on words nobody said, a deduction rule inverted makes the backup the owner, a first-name match too eager points a role at the wrong colleague, a reader narrowing dropped shows unreviewed claims to a business reader. Scoped like the sibling API configs: these files plus their own unit tests, which are self-contained (no repository paths outside the sandbox, no PostgreSQL). MUTATOR SET: StringLiteral and ObjectLiteral disabled, matching the sibling configs -- so the SQL in store.js / subjects.js / decide.js is not mutated and stays the contract test's job (contract-tests/contextInterviews.contract.test.js). Also the Authorization workbench (docs/architecture/m1-discovery-and-design.md): the activity / expertise / duty objects, an analyst's own link, the unit read and its assembly (one row per person, the best grant over accounts, link states) and its routes; and saving an investigation (M2a: the draft check, which proposal id a save keeps, clearing what the draft no longer holds). Run: cd app/api && npm run test:mutation:contextinterviews NOT YET MEASURED: this config ships with the feature; break is deliberately absent until a first run measures a score.
